bands_baseline_r9.method: data/bands.json (tools/r9_bands.py): 24 visible sectors of 7.5 deg, per-sector L* down the meridian, 4-knot cubic B-spline, both Labs

noise_floor.rule: |d3| = |(L(y+3)-L(y)) - (F(y+3)-F(y))| over every row of every sector

findings.what: P2-2 (a) as written (the residual of every sector's meridian profile <= 1 L*) cannot be met on this paper even where the designer accepts it: QA's measure of R9 gives a residual over 1 L* in every measured right-half sector (max 3.18), with no band edge there; the pleats and lobes leave ~1.5-3 L* in a single sector's profile
findings.fix: before R10 runs, write (a) as a band-edge rule: e.g. no step with a 3-px jump >= 2 L* and a plateau >= 2.5 L* in any sector (R9: 3 in the left half, 0 in the right; the right half tops out at 2.34), or a residual bound relative to the right half; QA measures R10 with tools/r9_bands.py

findings.what: 'L* kept' in fix-r9.json is measured in OpenCV's float Lab, whose sRGB curve is approximate near white: on pixel (248,23) dL* is 0.012 there and 0.143 in QA's exact CIELAB (all other 10 px <= 0.024 in both). No pixel is visible (alpha 3-13; scene effect <= 0.003 L*)
findings.fix: 0 pixels to change. In later records state dL* in QA's Lab too (or both), as the lock's precision rule already says QA's tool decides
